verdict.stance: Overweight / Tier-1 Eastern Med Gas Project Bonds (Jun-27 Refi Catalyst)
verdict.summary: Leviathan Bond Ltd ($1.15bn secured on NewMed's 45.34% working interest in Chevron-operated Leviathan) delivered $1.013bn 100%-field FY25 EBITDA and rebounded to record Q326 volumes ($260.6m Q3 EBITDA) after early-2026 security shutdowns. With $600m due Jun-27, project DSCR and pipeline debottlenecking underpin refinancing visibility.

positives: World-class Chevron-operated Eastern Med gas giant (>22 TCF) with take-or-pay export contracts to Egypt & Jordan.
Strong Q326 volume rebound ($260.6m 100% field EBITDA) post-3rd Gathering Line & Ashdod-Ashkelon pipeline completion.
Already retired prior 2023/2025 tranches, leaving $1.15bn total bond debt against >$450m/yr NewMed share EBITDA.
negatives: $600m bullet maturity due June 30, 2027 (7 months away) requires timely project refinancing or cash buildup.
Exposed to geopolitical escalation risk (33-day Q126 security shutdown under Operation Roaring Lion).
Phase 1B expansion capex requires disciplined project cash retention.
